criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: 3 and 4 are real evidence art; 7 weakest (boom between two plates, UI-like board, dead top); 8 type on a plate; 5's tape unreadable at 432 px; 2's cameras stubs; a black back-wall slab behind 3 and 4.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Could not refute any numeral; c28 supports the vendor line; c12 missing from the first comment's id list; 'owns part of Apella' drops 'minority' with the quote beneath.

contested: c12 missing from the first comment's id list

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Primitive boom, UI-like board in an off-deck palette, empty black top.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A physical board in the deck's steel and green with one gold strip, the camera on one real mount, tile raised to the dek, the camera's cast across the board.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The white tape reads as faint grey wedges.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A bright white stripe of real height with its own cast; a few degrees off plan.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A pale mid tone page, the one light frame.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Crop the page into dark steel on three sides, rake the key low, the lower third in shadow.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A hard black back-wall base slab behind the wall on 3 and 4.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Extend the floor and pool to the far wall or lower the wall base below the horizon.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Cameras as dark stubs, a flat plan.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pale lit housings with long casts; taller walls.

_note: Transcribed from the judge's hand-back by the showrunner; scores, total and weakest frames as returned, reasons abridged.
